Parent `7754a8054b8e1fdf0eeb12d69f23e6d2e1b0379b`; head `5953a6faa42935ca18dfca324c869ede8624b63c`. No deployed/hosted/physical taste outcome claim. **CI UNEXECUTED when opening; HOLD merge and READY until exact checks pass.** Never deploy, write production, change visibility/main/release, or force Git.

Closes no issue. #267 line audit and #33 immutable corpus are independent.
